# PhonixPBX - Raspberry Pi boot configuration (PHXBOOT:/config.txt)
#
# Do not edit: the A/B updater selects the system slot in slot.txt
# (os_prefix=slotA/ or slotB/: kernel, initramfs, cmdline.txt, device trees
# and overlays are loaded from that directory). Put local additions such as
# dtoverlay= lines into usercfg.txt.
[all]
arm_64bit=1
kernel=vmlinuz
initramfs initramfs followkernel
cmdline=cmdline.txt
enable_uart=1
disable_splash=1
boot_delay=0
avoid_warnings=1

[pi4]
enable_gic=1

[all]
include slot.txt
include usercfg.txt
